projects.title: Lumen TV
projects.summary: A TV-style streaming app you control with a remote.
points: Focus-based navigation with arrow keys, OK and Back, including Samsung Tizen and LG webOS remote keys
HLS player with automatic reconnect, media-error recovery and a clear error screen with retry
1920×1080 layout that scales to any screen, with the video player loaded on demand

images.alt: Lumen TV home screen with a hero banner and rows of titles
Lumen TV details screen for Sintel with Play and Back buttons
Lumen TV player error screen with Try again and Back

projects.title: Lumen Studio
projects.summary: An Angular admin dashboard for managing the Lumen catalog.
points: Dashboard with hand-built SVG charts: daily views with a hover and keyboard crosshair, views by genre and titles by status
Titles table with debounced search, filters, sortable columns, pagination and loading, empty and error states
Edit drawer with reactive form validation, plus light and dark themes

images.alt: Lumen Studio overview dashboard with charts and key numbers
Lumen Studio titles table in dark mode
Lumen Studio edit drawer showing validation errors

projects.title: Huddle
projects.summary: A responsive social feed where you can post, like, comment and save.
points: Posts with photos resized in the browser, likes, comments, sharing and a saved list
Clickable hashtags, trending topics, search and Latest/Top sorting
Three-column desktop layout that becomes a bottom tab bar on phones, with light and dark themes

images.alt: Huddle home feed with composer, posts and trending sidebar

projects.title: Payback
projects.summary: A loan and mortgage calculator that shows what extra payments save you.
points: Monthly payment, total interest and payoff date that update as you type or drag the sliders
Balance chart comparing regular and extra payments, plus a yearly breakdown
GEL, USD and EUR, shareable links with every input kept in the URL

images.alt: Payback loan calculator with inputs and monthly payment
Payback results in dark mode with savings message
Payback remaining balance chart and yearly breakdown table

projects.title: Lumen API
projects.summary: The REST API behind the Lumen catalog, built with Node.js and Express.
points: JWT authentication with editor and admin roles, bcrypt password hashing
Titles CRUD with search, filters, sorting and pagination; catalog stats aggregated with Sequelize
Zod validation with field-level errors, Swagger docs and 15 integration tests

images.alt: Lumen API Swagger documentation listing all endpoints
Swagger try-it-out response for listing Fantasy titles

points: Angular web app: video player integration, error handling and monitoring
Node.js/TypeScript/Express backend: REST APIs, Sequelize, DRM proxy, unit tests
Smart TV app for Samsung Tizen and a React admin panel
Built and maintained web applications for client projects
